prompt: Use case illustration-story. ONE gorgeous 16:9 landscape background image for children's presentation, 1536x864 full bleed. Top-down dreamy tropical beach with pale warm sandy center making 65% open space. Watercolor and delicate gouache, premium illustrated travel journal aesthetic. Clear turquoise ocean with exquisitely painted foam ripples restricted to top 15% and rightmost edge, tiny pink scallop shells, sea glass, starfish clustered lower corners, palm fronds entering top left, small red sand bucket and spade at lower right. Rich organic detail and sunlit rippling caustics at edges, central sand softly textured warm cream, no footprints across center. Keep x22–78%, y20–72% quiet pale sand for later dark text and photos. Fresh summery aqua, cream, coral. No text, logos, numbers, watermark, UI, border, collage or sample content. One cohesive beach artwork, opaque.
